# Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh of Śrīla Gurudev and Śrīla Guru Mahārāj **the home of pure devotion**
Founded in 1941 by Śrīla Guru Mahārāj Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj, and developed by Śrīla Gurudev Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj, the fountainhead of distri­bution of pure devotion to the world:     Sri Chaitanya Saraswat Math\     Kolerganj,\     Post Office: Nabadwip\     District: Nadia,\     West Bengal, Pin 741302, India     Web: [scsmath.com](https://www.scsmath.com)     With Spiritually Affiliated Centres Worldwide
